title: Pegasus Spyware: An Attack System Artemis
subtitle: IEEE ICECAA · Aug 2023
description: Co-authored study examining the technical intricacies of Pegasus spyware. Explores propagation methods, zero-day vulnerability exploitation, and HTTPS command-and-control channels. Reveals the elusive nature of Pegasus and the minimal traces it leaves on infected systems.

title: NFT Analytical Modelling on Blockchain Data
subtitle: IEEE ICNWC · May 2023
description: ETL pipelines transforming EVM-node data into a centralized database for analytical modelling. Recommends potential uprising high-value NFTs via SparkSQL visualization and a cross-platform Flutter front-end.

title: Dynamic Network Architecture for IoT
subtitle: IEEE ICICCS · Dec 2022
description: Proposed an architecture for connecting 200+ IoT devices seamlessly without bandwidth degradation. Uses the Arduino Uno WiFi REV2 as a bridge between WiFi and Zigbee communication.
